rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an adorably cute child, animal, object, or charming person.

example.jyutping: zek3 maau1 zai2 zan1 hai6 dak1 ji3

rows.note: Choose this more explicit equivalent when emphasizing that someone or something is lovable and pleasing rather than merely good-looking.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau2 zai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 oi3

rows.note: Use this when “cute” focuses on someone’s attractive appearance, including a sexually attractive person or body part.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when the cute manner is deliberately coquettish, affected, or put on.

example.english: They act all cute and coquettish when flirting.
example.traditional: 佢扮到嗲嗲哋咁同人撒嬌。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baan6 dou3 de1 de1 dei2 gam2 tung4 jan4 saat3 giu1
